_comment: ONE table of cases for the initiative arithmetic, run by BOTH tests/test_roll_engine.py (roll_engine.py: initiative_sort_value / initiative_action_values) and tests/js/shared_cases.test.js (roll_math.js: initiativeSortValue / initiativeActionValues). The sheet rolls initiative in the browser and /initiative rolls it on the server; R2.1 of the slash-command requirements is that the same dice give the same action dice either way.

sort_value.name: an ordinary die sorts by its value
a Kakita 10 is Phase 0 and sorts first

action_values.name: Hiruma 4th Dan lowers each by 2, never below 1
Shinjo 4th Dan turns the highest into a 1
order matters: Hiruma runs before Kakita, so a 10 becomes 8 not 0
